description: See what the buyer support agent would do with a buyer's message: reply (and the text), leave it for the seller, or skip, with its reason. Sends nothing. Pass `rules` or `policy` to try a change before saving it.

channel.description: Which channel to answer as. Optional.

policy.description: Shop notes to try instead of the saved ones.

rules.description: Rules to try instead of the saved ones.

id.description: The id of an existing rule. Omit for a new rule.

text.description: The rule, in plain words. At most 600 characters.

name: try_support_agent
